detected.question: Fetch the whole playlist, or this track only?

options.title: Options
options.categoryHint: Context, not musical style — where the music comes from. You can change it later on any track.

destination.autoHint: Each track rejoins the album of its own release — the normal path, and the right one for almost every link.
destination.existingHint: Whatever arrives joins the chosen album from your library, after its own tracks. The album keeps its cover and its nature.
destination.problem: A hand-built playlist gathers tracks from different albums: filed as they come, each rejoins its own. This files them under the album you name, leaving their artist and genre alone.
destination.tryWithout: Try without it first: a soundtrack already released as an album is recognised on its own. Forcing only helps when no such album exists.
destination.newSingleHint: The track founds this new album. With no artist named, it keeps its own.
destination.title: Album title
destination.titlePlaceholder: Name of the film, series, game…

detail.unavailable_one: {{count}} video in the playlist couldn't be fetched: removed, made private or blocked. That doesn't necessarily leave the album incomplete — playlists often carry duplicates, or entries whoever built it never took out. Compare the list below against the album you expected before hunting elsewhere.
detail.unavailable_other: {{count}} videos in the playlist couldn't be fetched: removed, made private or blocked. That doesn't necessarily leave the album incomplete — playlists often carry duplicates, or entries whoever built it never took out. Compare the list below against the album you expected before hunting elsewhere.

move.title: Change the destination
move.hint: Regroups this download's tracks onto another record, without downloading anything again. The cure for a playlist the automatic filing split into several albums.

redownload.title: Download again
redownload.hint: Queues the same address again, with the destination of your choice. If the old content is still in the library, undo this download first — otherwise the duplicates will be dropped.
